duration_policy: 15-90 seconds; editorial beats must be explicitly authored
cut_rhythm: hook in first 2 seconds; escalating beats with no arbitrary speed-up
narration: requires approved script and measured segments
voice: approved narrator only; no unregistered voice substitution
music: approved source only; ducking, limiter and rights status required
effects: profile is not production-ready until an authored effects plan exists
medallion: optional, only through approved character identity
transitions: authored per beat; generic defaults are not sufficient for release
